text:
I had a single-tooth denture made here, and unfortunately it was the worst denture experience I’ve ever had.

In the past, I have always received acrylic single-tooth dentures that attach discreetly to the teeth on either side of the missing tooth. They were small, comfortable, easy to wear, and allowed me to speak and eat normally.

What I received from this clinic was completely different. The denture was extremely large, covering around 60% of the roof of my mouth. It was thick, bulky, and felt very low quality. Before treatment, I explained that I expected a small, removable denture similar to those I had received previously. Instead, I was given something so uncomfortable that I could barely eat properly. Speaking felt like trying to talk with a mouth full of food.

When I raised my concerns, I was told they had never heard of the type of denture I had received from other dentists. That response was surprising, as this is not a new or uncommon option. If that’s the case, I would suggest the clinic become more familiar with the products and treatment options available in the market so patients can be offered more competitive and modern solutions.

As for pricing, this clinic is not inexpensive. Considering the quality of the denture, the service provided, and the overall experience, I found it significantly overpriced.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this clinic.

text:
I found this clinic on TikTok in the On Nut area. My first impression was the quick response from the admin and clear answers. So, I decided to have two wisdom teeth extracted here because cavities were causing toothaches. I don't have a regular dental office, and I'm actually afraid of going to the dentist. But when I got there, the assistant staff and dentist were very professional. The dentist explained the dental x-rays in detail, understanding the risks and characteristics of my teeth, and the assistants were very helpful. I highly recommend this place to anyone who doesn't go to the dentist often or has other dental issues. The prices are very reasonable. I love it.
Parking is available at Big C or the police station, and it's a short walk away. Alternatively, if you're coming by BTS, get off at On Nut Station (Exit 1).

text:
The dentist on duty at the clinic on Tuesdays even speaks Chinese! They have an advanced airflow dental polisher, so come here to remove tea and coffee stains—you won't regret it!

Airflow dental polishing uses high-pressure water and airflow to quickly clean teeth, removing stains from smoking, tea, and other pigments faster and more thoroughly, and preventing tartar and stains from re-accumulating.

Before the cleaning, they took X-rays, and the dentist carefully checked my entire mouth for cavities and other problems. The cleaning process was gentle, meticulous, and very thorough. After the treatment, they even taught me the correct brushing technique and patiently answered any questions I had. Highly recommended!
